text: It's only when you look at an ant through a magnifying glass on a sunny day that you realise how often they burst into flames.
author: Clive James

archive.text: If you cannot be silent be brilliant and thoughtful.
archive.author: Byron Pulsifer

archive.text: If one advances confidently in the direction of his dream, and endeavours to live the life which he had imagines, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
archive.author: Henry David Thoreau

archive.text: The good thing about science is that it's true whether or not you believe in it.
archive.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

archive.text: It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
archive.author: Seneca

archive.text: Never argue with stupid people, they will drag you down to their level and then beat you with experience.
archive.author: Mark Twain

archive.text: There is no passion to be found playing small — in settling for a life that is less than the one you are capable of living.
archive.author: Nelson Mandela

archive.text: Yeah we all shine on, like the moon, and the stars, and the sun.
archive.author: John Lennon
